title: Event
description: One frame of GET /api/events (personal-assistant/src/dashboard/events.js): the `data:` JSON of a Server-Sent Event, whose `id:` is the same id. Payloads carry ids and states, never content. Ids are opaque to clients; send the last one back as Last-Event-ID.

id.description: g<seq> for a change the database numbered (the same in every process; replayable from the outbox), <epoch>-<n> for one published in one process

topic.description: board, run, factory, routine, ...; hello and resync are control frames

payload.description: From a table change: {table, op, id, <the columns the trigger names>}. hello: {epoch}. resync: {reason}.
